original_answer.example_en: First thing in the morning, I check my messages.

original_answer.usage_note: 指早晨很早或首先做某事，不必是字面上的第一件物品。

two_case_independent_review.cg_qa_independent_semantic_reason: 清晨一开始、早晨第一件事这样用，未蕴含醒来立刻；First thing in the morning, I check my messages与新中文对齐，call first thing in the morning搭配正常；不过“清晨”常指早些时候而非严格黎明，当前语用可接受。

original_answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.
original_answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束就把衣物取出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
original_answer.usage_note: take out表示从洗衣机中取出；此源项是待独立审核增补候选。

revised_answer.meaning_zh: 把衣物拿出来；（本场景）从洗衣机取出衣物
revised_answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.
revised_answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束就把衣物取出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
revised_answer.usage_note: take the laundry out指把衣物拿出来，本身不要求衣物已经洗好；例句中as soon as the cycle finishes才表示程序结束后取出。

identity_collision.independent_reason: Prep ingredients and prep the ingredients denote the same preparing-food-ingredients act; definite article only marks context and is not a separate semantic skill. Both source examples are natural and bilingual, yet changing determiner does not establish independent KU. The '预处理' versus '准备' nuance is not demonstrated as a distinct taught sense by actual examples; a stable Master source sentence and Sense mapping are needed.
